name: YouTube-like Player Gesture Controls
description: YouTube-style video player controls: double-tap to skip back/forward, hold to play at 2x, drag to scrub, J/L/,/. keyboard shortcuts, and a mute state that is remembered across devices.
author: Ashaman

versions.changelog: Initial release: double-tap to skip back/forward (accumulating), press-and-hold 2x playback, drag-to-scrub with live target time, J/L/,/./</>/Home/End keys, and a per-user muted state remembered on the server. Settings panel under Settings → Extensions.
